# BuzzyBrains Academy

> BuzzyBrains Academy is a coaching institute in Pune, India, offering IIT-JEE, NEET, Olympiad, Foundation (Grades 6-10), and international-board (IGCSE/IB/AP/SAT) preparation. Batches are capped at 12 students, taught by IITian and IIM-alumni faculty, with AI-powered learning tools. Founded on 25+ years of combined teaching experience.

Key facts: batches capped at 12 students; faculty are IIT/IIM alumni; centres in Amanora and Kharadi, Pune; phone +91-89836-04478; email hello@buzzybrainsacademy.com.

## Programs

- [Foundation Program (Grades 6-10)](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation): conceptual groundwork in Maths and Science before board/competitive exams.
- [IIT-JEE Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/12th-board-pcm): JEE Main and Advanced preparation for Grade 11-12 PCM students and droppers.
- [NEET Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/12th-board-pcb): NEET preparation for Grade 11-12 PCB students.
- [Board Exam Test Series](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/test-series): CBSE/ICSE Grade 10 & 12 mock exam series with examiner-style evaluation.
- [Olympiad Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/olympiads): Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and coding olympiads (IOQM, SOF, NMTC, AMC, Math Kangaroo).
- [Commerce Tuitions](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/commerce-tuitions): Class 11-12 Commerce, plus CUET and CA Foundation coaching.
- [International Boards](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/international-boards): IGCSE, IB and AP exam coaching.
- [Code Ninja](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/coding-lab) and [Programming Classes](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/programming-classes): coding, AI foundations and computational logic for Grades 6-12.
- [One-on-One Coaching](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/one-on-one): personalized 1-on-1 mentoring across all subjects.
- [Ivy League Counselling](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/ivy-league-counselling): US university application and profile-building guidance.

## 2026-27 Crash Courses

Short, weightage-first pre-exam sprint batches (8 weeks, capped at 12 students), distinct from the year-round programs above.

- [MHT CET Crash Course](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/mht-cet-crash-course-pune): sprint into MHT CET 2027 Session 1 (Dec 15, 2026 - Jan 15, 2027), led by Dilip Sir, with support carried through the Session 2 attempt in April 2027 and results in May.
- [10th CBSE Maths & Science Crash Course](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/10th-cbse-crash-course-pune): CBSE Class 10 Maths and Science, led by Arun Sir and Dr. Urmila, ahead of the Feb-March 2027 board exams.
- [10th ICSE Crash Course](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/10th-icse-crash-course-pune): all four ICSE Class 10 papers — Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology — each with a named subject specialist.
- [12th CBSE PCMB Crash Course](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/12th-cbse-crash-course-pune): CBSE Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths (PCM) and Biology (PCB), led by founder Dilip Sir with named subject specialists.

## Free Tools

All tools are mentored by IITian faculty, free, and require no signup.

- [Resource Centre](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/resource-centre): hub for every free tool below.
- [NEET & JEE Main Rank + College Predictor](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/neet-jee-rank-predictor): enter an expected NEET score or JEE Main percentile, get an honest banded read on realistic college outcomes.
- [NEET & JEE Main Score Calculator](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/score-calculator): enter correct/incorrect/unattempted counts, get an exact score using the real official marking scheme.
- [JEE Quick Quiz](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/jee-quiz): 10 Physics, Chemistry and Maths questions at JEE Main level, instant scoring with explanations.
- [NEET Quick Quiz](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/neet-quiz): 10 Physics, Chemistry and Biology questions at NEET level, instant scoring with explanations.
- [Study Timetable Generator](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/study-timetable-generator): mark coaching/heavy days, get a realistic weekly JEE/NEET timetable with subject rotation, a mock day and real rest.
- [Mock Test Schedule Planner](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/mock-test-planner): enter your exam date, get a phased mock-test calendar (diagnostic, core, intensive, taper).
- [Board Exam Study Planner](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/board-exam-study-planner): free printable study planner for CBSE/ICSE/SSC Class 10 & 12.
- [Class 6 Maths Quiz](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation-maths-quiz-class-6), [Class 7](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation-maths-quiz-class-7), [Class 8](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation-maths-quiz-class-8), [Class 9](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation-maths-quiz-class-9), [Class 10](https://buzzybrainsacademy.com/foundation-maths-quiz-class-10): free 10-question Foundation Maths quizzes with instant scoring and explanations.
